about: Zenkai Z1 intent examples: tests/host_support.py::assert_isolated_library, the guard that keeps a host probe's darktable off Pratik's real library.db and real photos (standing isolation rule, 2026-11-08). {scratch} is a throwaway stand-in for ~/Pictures/ScouterScratch and {real} for ~/.config/darktable/library.db. Two oracles (Z2): whether it raised, and that the message names the cause; accepted cases also check the launch argv carries --library with that exact path.
subject: tests/host_support.py::assert_isolated_library

examples.source: the one file this guard exists to protect: a host probe importing frames and writing history into Pratik's real library.
a string prefix check would accept this path; resolving it shows it leaves the scratch dir.
